Name: Yri's Modular Retro Style Trees
Author: YriKururu
Description:
[center][size=3][u]
[/u][u]Installation:[/u]
1. Download the file
2. Unpack
3. Drag into your mods folder 
4. Select all your option with the generic config menu
5. Enjoy!

[u]Installation for AT:[/u]
1. Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] and the optinal AT file
2. Unpack both mods
3. Drag into your mods folder 
4. Use the 'paintbucket' or 'spraycan' to select your colors
5. Enjoy!

[u]Installation for Bushes:[/u]
1. Download the file
2. Unpack
3. Drag into your mods folder 
4. Select all your option with the generic config menu
5. Enjoy!
Thanks to Wildflour for this Pack

[u]Information on how to config your files![/u]
[u][b]Select one of the two options Base OR Advanced NEVER BOTH[/b][/u]
Base allows you to recolor ALL trees at once
Advanced allows you to recolor INDIVIDUAL trees separately 
If you want to use this mod with for example simple foliage you can simply disable trees you don't want. 

[b][u]IF YOU DISABLE JASTREE YOU ALSO NEED TO DISABLE THE CHERRY TREES![/u]
[/b]If you don't disable the cherry trees and Jastree together the tree will look messed up!
It shouldn't cause problems but like always: Make sure to back up your mods folder!

Please remember i'm not a professional! I do this in my sparetime on an amateur level so please excuse any errors and pixel mistakes!
[/size]

[size=3][url=https://aamatniekss.itch.io/grasslands-era-of-fantasy-pixelart-asset-pack]Era of Fantasy Asset Pack[/url] (For some of the Trees)
